state.title: No full page reload on server/app updates
state.body: User in #wt-pack. Two forced reloads today: (1) web/src/main.tsx reloads on 403 + x-herdr-session — a server restart invalidates the session (check whether the cookie/session secret is regenerated per start; persist it so a restart keeps sessions); (2) web/src/desktop.tsx reloads the Mac app on every new web build id. Replace (2) with an 'Update available · Reload' toast (auto-apply only when the tab is hidden/idle and no composer draft); after a server restart just reconnect SSE + refetch queries. Also keep composer drafts, open panel and scroll across any reload (URL hash + sessionStorage). Verify: restart service while typing a draft → no reload, draft kept.
